analysis_unit: 先在同一訊號日期平均 TWSE/TPEX 市場單元，再按月份作區塊重抽樣
bootstrap_interpretation: 95% percentile interval and empirical positive-effect probability; not a causal p-value
independent_signal_warning: Adjacent calendar-month blocks are resampled to reduce, but not eliminate, time dependence.
notes: All factor high-minus-low spreads remain descriptive factor associations, not causal effects.
For model rank columns, smaller numeric rank is treated as the better-ranked group; sign is reversed to compare better rank minus worse rank.
Monthly moving-block bootstrap preserves local serial structure but does not eliminate long-range dependence or selection bias.
H=10 has fewer dates and months; any result with insufficient monthly coverage is marked INSUFFICIENT_MONTHS.
The source v4.85.1 analysis uses only general-stock baseline cost and already-included valid trades.
